summary: Backend testing completed for JW Receive GRN feature (SC with RM flow). All 24 tests passed covering: (1) POST /api/job-work/receive-grn creates GRN from JW number with process cost, (2) JW GRN adds FG/SA stock correctly, (3) JW GRN creates inventory transaction with jw_grn reference type, (4) JW GRN marks SC as completed when all parts received, (5) JW GRN tracks total_process_cost, (6) Partial JW GRN doesn't complete SC, (7) Regression: DC creation with RM deducts stock, (8) DC print includes HSN column for both Part Details and RM tables.
seed_data_creation: Test data created dynamically with TEST_ prefix for items (RM, SA), suppliers, SC orders, DCs, and GRNs
context_for_next_testing_agent: All JW Receive GRN features verified: (1) POST /api/job-work/receive-grn creates GRN directly from SC order ID with process_charges per line. (2) GRN adds stock for received items (SA/FG). (3) Inventory transaction created with reference_type='jw_grn'. (4) Partial receive: received_quantity tracked on job_work_parts, SC not completed until all parts received. (5) Full receive: SC marked completed with completed_at timestamp. (6) GRN stored in 'grn' collection with jw_order_id and jw_order_number fields. (7) DC creation with RM correctly deducts stock (regression verified). (8) DC includes HSN codes for both RM lines and job_work_parts.
tests_passed: test_02_create_test_items - Create RM, SA items with HSN codes
test_04_create_sc_order_with_rm - Create SC order with RM lines and job_work_parts
test_06_get_rm_stock_before_dc - Record RM stock before DC
test_07_send_dc_for_sc_with_rm - Create DC for SC with RM
test_08_verify_dc_deducted_rm_stock - Regression: DC deducts RM stock correctly
test_09_get_sa_stock_before_grn - Record SA stock before JW GRN
test_10_receive_grn_partial - Partial JW GRN (5 of 10 units)
test_11_verify_partial_grn_added_stock - Partial GRN adds SA stock
test_12_verify_sc_not_completed_after_partial - SC not completed after partial receive
test_14_verify_final_grn_added_stock - Final GRN adds remaining SA stock
test_15_verify_sc_completed - SC marked completed after all parts received
test_16_verify_grn_in_collection - GRN exists in collection with jw_order_id
TestDCPrintHSNColumn::test_01-06 - DC includes HSN codes for RM and job_work_parts

jw_receive_grn_endpoint.details: POST /api/job-work/receive-grn creates GRN from SC order ID with process_charges per line. Returns grn_number, total_process_cost, and all_received flag.

jw_grn_adds_stock.details: JW GRN correctly adds stock for received items (SA/FG). Stock updated in items collection.

jw_grn_inventory_transaction.details: Inventory transaction created with reference_type='jw_grn' and reference_id=grn_number.

jw_grn_completes_sc.details: SC order marked completed with completed_at timestamp when all job_work_parts are fully received.

jw_grn_tracks_process_cost.details: total_process_cost calculated as sum of (received_quantity * process_charges) for all lines.

partial_jw_grn.details: Partial receive updates received_quantity on job_work_parts but does not complete SC.

dc_hsn_column.details: DC includes HSN codes for both RM lines and job_work_parts (from item.hsn_code).

regression_dc_deducts_stock.details: DC creation with RM correctly deducts stock (skip_stock_deduct=false by default).
